name: bat
description: Cat with syntax highlighting, Git integration, and line numbers

bat.description: Enhanced cat with syntax highlighting and Git change markers
bat.usage:
bat main.py # Syntax highlighted file display
bat -n file.js # Show line numbers only
bat -A config.txt # Show all characters including whitespace
bat --diff file1.txt file2.txt # Show file differences with highlighting
bat --style=plain,header README.md # Minimal style with header only
